cmd:
K=$(grep ^GEMINI_API_KEY= /opt/weather-pipeline/repo/.env | cut -d= -f2- | tr -d "\"" | tr -d "'"); curl -s "https://generativelanguage.googleapis.com/v1beta/models?pageSize=200&key=$K" | python3 -c "
import json,sys
d=json.load(sys.stdin)
for m in d.get(\"models\",[]):
    n=m[\"name\"].split(\"/\")[1]
    if \"generateContent\" in m.get(\"supportedGenerationMethods\",[]) and n.startswith(\"gemini\"): print(n)
" | sort | tr "\n" " "
